name: ไลฟ์ Claim Guard
idea: Listens to a Shopee Live beauty or supplement stream and flags illegal health claims seconds after the host says them.
twist: Whispers a compliant Thai rephrase to the host's earpiece, catching phrases like 'หายขาด' before viewers hear them twice.

name: ละครช้อป
idea: Fans pause a Thai drama or BL series clip and instantly get the outfit or prop matched to Shopee listings.
twist: Ranks small Thai sellers above imports and builds 'wear what the actor wore' bundles from fandom screenshots.

name: CF Catcher
idea: Turns 'CF' comments, LINE messages and transfer slips from Facebook Live sales into confirmed orders with ShopeePay links.
twist: Understands Thai CF slang like 'CF2 สีแดง' and resolves who claimed the last piece first across channels.

name: โทรสั่งได้
idea: A voice agent answers a small restaurant's phone, takes Thai orders and pushes them into the ShopeeFood kitchen queue.
twist: Handles Isan and Northern dialects and suggests dishes that use up ingredients before closing time.

name: No-Menu Bank Line
idea: MariBank's phone line drops the IVR menu; callers describe the problem and the agent resolves card freezes and slip disputes.
twist: Notices scam-pressure signals in an elder's voice and calmly pauses the transfer before finishing the request.

name: ประชุมหมู่บ้าน Minutes
idea: Records village meetings and turns them into decisions, owners and deadlines tracked until done.
twist: Transcribes regional dialects and writes the follow-up as a script for the village loudspeaker tower and LINE OpenChat.

name: Dropout Radar
idea: Combines attendance, grades and home-visit notes into a dropout risk score per student and suggests interventions.
twist: Fits Thai home-visit (เยี่ยมบ้าน) records and recommends specific equity-fund or scholarship routes to the homeroom teacher.

name: Discharge Diet Ordering
idea: Reads a hospital discharge diet sheet and filters ShopeeFood menus so caregivers order safely for a recovering patient.
twist: Estimates sodium and potassium in Thai dishes like ส้มตำปลาร้า for kidney patients and asks the dietitian when unsure.

name: มือสอง Grader
idea: Grades used phones from photos and settings screenshots for Shopee second-hand listings and detects suspicious evidence.
twist: Checks battery-health screenshots for editing, reads Thai repair stickers and prices by local มือสอง market rates.

name: ทุนหาเรา · grant matcher
idea: Matches a Shopee seller to Thai SME support schemes and drafts the application from real sales data.
twist: Uses shop performance and order history as evidence, so sellers without accountants can apply for support programmes.

name: น้ำมา Rescue Map
idea: Reads flood help posts from Facebook and X, geolocates them and dispatches nearby volunteers with supplies.
twist: Parses Thai posts with landmarks like 'ซอยหลังวัด' and lets ShopeeFood riders opt in as dry-route supply runners.

name: ดูแลใจ Care Match
idea: Helps care managers match bed-bound elders with home caregivers by needs, skills, distance and family budget.
twist: Reads Thai long-term-care assessment forms and plans weekly visits for village caregivers (CG) across a tambon.

name: โอนช้าๆ
idea: Before an elder sends a large ShopeePay transfer, AI reads the context and asks a family member in LINE to confirm.
twist: Recognises Thai scam scripts like fake DSI or parcel-customs calls and explains the risk in kind, plain language.

name: 7 วันอันตราย Triage
idea: Guides bystanders through triage and first aid at multi-victim road crashes until the ambulance arrives.
twist: Built for Songkran and New Year crashes; streams triage tags and location to 1669 dispatchers.

name: บิลลายมือ Order Desk
idea: Reads distributor orders from LINE photos of handwritten slips and voice notes and enters them into stock software.
twist: Reads messy Thai handwriting with shop nicknames; staff only confirm uncertain lines.

name: ป้าสั่งได้
idea: Elders shop on Shopee by speaking; the agent picks products and asks a family member to approve payment.
twist: Understands dialect and vague requests like 'ยาหม่องอันเดิม' by checking past orders.

name: ลอตเตอรี่ Eyes
idea: A chest-mounted phone helps blind lottery vendors move through markets and confirm cash and PromptPay payments by voice.
twist: Identifies Thai banknotes and reads the payment confirmation screen aloud, so vendors can't be short-changed.

name: ER Pre-Arrival
idea: Families describe symptoms by LINE on the way to a community hospital and the ER gets a triage level before arrival.
twist: Uses the Thai MOPH ED triage levels and prepares a one-screen summary for the duty nurse.

name: คอนโดจริงไหม
idea: Checks Facebook condo rental posts for scam signs before a renter transfers a deposit.
twist: Reverse-searches listing photos across groups and asks the building's juristic office to verify the unit.

name: Free Fire Gamble Hunter
idea: Detects illegal gambling ads spread through game chats, clan names and livestreams and maps the network behind them.
twist: Decodes Thai obfuscated spam like 'ส ล็ อ ต' and links it to accounts for Garena enforcement.

name: เพชรพอดี · kids top-up coach
idea: A story-based game teaches teens to budget their Garena top-ups and pocket money, with a parent dashboard.
twist: Uses Free Fire diamond prices and real top-up history so lessons feel like the game, not a lecture.

name: ทริปคุ้ม Insurance
basedOn: AI Insurance Chatbot Platform (Team Rep Monkeys)
idea: Reads flight and hotel booking screenshots and recommends travel cover that matches the actual trip activities.
twist: Spots risky Thai trip activities like Koh Tao diving or Japan ski days and explains exclusions in plain Thai.

name: ถุงยา Reconciler
idea: Photographs an elder's pills and drug bags from several hospitals and finds duplicates and dangerous combinations.
twist: Reads Thai hospital drug labels, prepares a list for the village health volunteer and flags generics with different brand names.

name: RoV Clip Finder
idea: Creators search Garena esports VODs in plain Thai, like 'clutch teamfight at baron', and get clip timestamps.
twist: Understands Thai caster commentary and slang, then cuts ready-to-post vertical highlights for Thai creators.

name: จอประสาทตา Screening Ops
idea: Schedules diabetic eye screening rounds, reads retinal photos and routes urgent cases to provincial eye clinics.
twist: Designed for รพ.สต. with one shared camera; plans which villages get screened each week.

name: ภาษีนำเข้า Shock Test
idea: Shows cross-border sellers how a tariff, VAT or port disruption changes landed cost and suggests new prices.
twist: Simulates Thai rules on low-value imports and compares China-sourced stock with Thai-made alternatives.

name: บอทไม่มั่ว
idea: A second model checks every AI chat reply from a Shopee shop and blocks false warranty, stock or shipping promises.
twist: Checks Thai replies against the shop's own policy and stock, and catches polite-but-wrong Thai answers.

name: สูตรแม่ Keeper
idea: Records a family cook preparing dishes and turns tacit know-how into standard recipes and training cards for new staff.
twist: Converts 'ใส่พอประมาณ' into measured amounts from video, keeping taste consistent as a ShopeeFood kitchen grows.

name: เลขบัตรปลอม Test Data
idea: Generates realistic synthetic Thai customer data for testing fintech and e-commerce systems without real personal data.
twist: Produces valid-checksum Thai ID numbers, real tambon addresses and Thai name spellings for PDPA-safe testing.

name: พัสดุหาย Agent Network
idea: Seller, courier and buyer agents negotiate a lost-parcel case together, sharing evidence until one settlement is agreed.
twist: Each agent follows its party's Thai platform rules, so cases close without three-way phone tag.

name: งานทีละขั้น
idea: Turns packing and café tasks into picture-by-picture spoken steps for workers with cognitive disabilities.
twist: Built for Thai social-enterprise cafés and Shopee packing jobs, working offline on a cheap phone.

name: พูดได้ Order
idea: Stroke survivors with slurred speech order food and pay by voice using a model tuned to their own speech.
twist: Learns Thai tones from a short personal recording session, since slurred Thai tones change word meaning.

name: ห้องเรียนดอย
idea: An offline school server gives a hill-area school a tutor, lesson library and progress tracking without internet.
twist: Bridges Karen or Hmong home languages to Thai curriculum and syncs reports when a teacher reaches signal.

name: KidBright Blocks
idea: Students build projects with visual blocks and the AI writes and explains the real microcontroller code behind them.
twist: Targets the KidBright boards already in Thai schools, with Thai explanations and local projects like smart rice-drying.

name: ช่างราคาแฟร์
idea: Homeowners photograph a leak or broken air-con, get likely causes and a fair price range, then a vetted technician.
twist: Checks contractor history against public records to avoid builders who take deposits and disappear.

name: Carbon Slip for Exporters
idea: Builds a carbon and ESG report for small exporters from invoices, electricity bills and shipping records.
twist: Prepares Thai SMEs for EU buyer questionnaires using Thai grid emission factors and supplier data.

name: สิทธิ์คนพิการ Filer
idea: Helps people with disabilities and families gather evidence and file disability card and allowance applications correctly.
twist: Maps medical certificates to Thai disability categories and lists what the local office will ask for.

name: รูปโดนขโมย
idea: Finds Shopee shops reusing a seller's product photos and assesses copyright infringement risk.
twist: Drafts a Thai takedown request with evidence of original upload time and image similarity.

name: OPD Twin
idea: A digital twin of a community hospital's outpatient flow finds the bottleneck behind long waits and tests fixes.
twist: Models Thai OPD steps like vital-signs queue and pharmacy, then tests moving refills to รพ.สต. pickup.

name: ไม่เผาอ้อย Advisor
idea: A voice advisor helps sugarcane and corn farmers plan harvest without burning, comparing cost and buyer options.
twist: Links to nearby harvester rental and biomass buyers so the no-burn plan is cheaper, not just greener.

name: ปศุสัตว์ Sentinel
idea: Combines farmer photo reports, satellite data and weather to warn of livestock disease spread like lumpy skin.
twist: Farmers report sick cattle by LINE photo; alerts go to the district livestock office with a risk map.

name: ทวงดีๆ
idea: An agent collects overdue credit from neighbourhood shops for small wholesalers with polite, staged LINE reminders.
twist: Matches Thai credit culture, offering instalments or PromptPay QR instead of harsh collection.

name: Probe TH
idea: An adversary agent poses as tricky Thai customers and a judge agent scores a bank's AI advisor on thousands of conversations.
twist: Tests Thai-only risks like mixed Thai-English, regional slang and elders who misunderstand loan terms.

name: Agent Wallet Mandate
idea: Users give their shopping agents a ShopeePay mandate with limits, and every agent payment is checked before execution.
twist: Family mandates let parents cap a teen's game top-ups or an elder's purchases with clear Thai receipts.

name: Parcel Pre-Load Check
idea: Scans parcel declarations before loading and flags risky items like lithium batteries or banned goods.
twist: Reads vague Thai item descriptions like 'ของใช้' against seller history to choose which parcels get inspected.

name: ลายมือบอก Dyslexia
idea: Screens handwriting samples for dyslexia signs and gives teachers tailored lesson plans.
twist: Tuned for Thai script errors like tone-mark and vowel placement, which English dyslexia tools miss.

name: ไลฟ์ภาษามือ
idea: Adds a Thai Sign Language avatar and live captions to Shopee Live so deaf buyers can follow and ask questions.
twist: Deaf viewers can sign questions back to the host, translated into Thai text in the chat.

name: ป่าชายเลน Watch
idea: Uses satellite images to detect coastal erosion and mangrove loss and alerts local councils with risk maps.
twist: Ranks Thai coastal tambons by erosion speed and drafts the อบต. budget request with evidence.

name: TCAS Essay Coach
idea: Grades Thai university admission essays and writing answers and builds a personal study plan and mock exams.
twist: Follows Thai writing rubrics and gives rural students without tutors the same feedback loop.

name: ประกันคุ้มไหม
idea: Reasons through a health insurance policy for a specific scenario and asks follow-up questions before saying covered or not.
twist: Turns Thai policy PDFs into machine-readable rules so buyers compare plans on Shopee before buying.
